title: Okta Organization Security Posture
description: Security posture metrics collected from an Okta organization. A metric the collector could not read is null or absent, and the collector result artifact records why.
comment: Optional fields are gated by collected_at_level: fields marked x-epack-level audit are present at audit and internal; fields marked internal are present only at internal.

schema_version.x-epack-summary: Version of the data shape this report follows. Fixed at 1.0.0 for this collector.

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when data was collected
collected_at.x-epack-summary: When the snapshot was taken, in UTC.

collected_at_level.description: Collection level this artifact was produced at. Levels are cumulative: audit is a superset of trust, internal of audit.

org_domain.x-epack-summary: The Okta organization this snapshot describes, such as company.okta.com.

posture.x-epack-summary: MFA and single sign-on adoption across the org.

mfa_coverage.description: Percentage of users with any MFA factor enrolled
mfa_coverage.x-epack-summary: Share of people with at least one active MFA method. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
mfa_coverage.x-epack-method: Reads each user's factors and divides the users with an active factor by the users other than deprovisioned ones.

mfa_enrolled_users_count.description: People other than deprovisioned ones with at least one active factor
mfa_enrolled_users_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people with at least one active MFA method, not counting deprovisioned accounts. MFA adoption is this number as a share of total people.
mfa_enrolled_users_count.x-epack-method: Reads each user's factors and counts the users other than deprovisioned ones with at least one active factor.

mfa_phishing_resistant.description: Percentage of users with phishing-resistant MFA (WebAuthn/FIDO2, U2F, or Okta FastPass)
mfa_phishing_resistant.x-epack-summary: Share of people with an active passkey, security key or Okta FastPass. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
mfa_phishing_resistant.x-epack-method: Reads each user's factors and divides the users with an active WebAuthn, U2F or FastPass factor by the users other than deprovisioned ones.

mfa_phishing_resistant_users_count.description: People with an active WebAuthn, U2F or FastPass factor
mfa_phishing_resistant_users_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people with an active passkey, security key or Okta FastPass. Phishing-resistant MFA adoption is this number as a share of total people.
mfa_phishing_resistant_users_count.x-epack-method: Reads each user's factors and counts the users with an active WebAuthn, U2F or FastPass factor.

sso_coverage.x-epack-summary: Share of apps that sign people in with SAML, OIDC or WS-Federation. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out.
sso_coverage.x-epack-method: Divides the apps whose sign-on mode is SAML 1.1, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect or WS-Federation by the org's apps. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out of both counts.

per_factor_type.description: Enrolled-user count per active factor type
per_factor_type.x-epack-summary: Number of people with each type of MFA method, one row for each factor type someone has enrolled.

factor_type.description: Okta factor type in lowercase, such as push, webauthn, sms, email, or token:software:totp.
factor_type.x-epack-summary: Okta factor type, such as webauthn, push, sms, email or token:software:totp.

enrolled_users.description: Number of non-deprovisioned users with at least one active factor of this type.
enrolled_users.x-epack-summary: Number of people with at least one active factor of this type. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.

mfa_disabled_users_count.description: Count of non-deprovisioned users with no active MFA
mfa_disabled_users_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people with no active MFA method. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.

users.x-epack-summary: Account status across the people in the directory, and a row for each person.

total_count.description: Users other than deprovisioned ones: the population of every user percentage
total_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people in the directory, not counting deprovisioned accounts. The account-health and MFA adoption percentages are shares of this number.
total_count.x-epack-method: Lists the org's users and counts each one whose status is not DEPROVISIONED.

password_expired.description: Percentage of users with expired passwords
password_expired.x-epack-summary: Share of people whose password has expired. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
password_expired.x-epack-method: Divides the users with the PASSWORD_EXPIRED status by the users other than deprovisioned ones.

password_expired_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people whose password has expired. The Expired passwords percentage is this number as a share of total people.
password_expired_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed users with the PASSWORD_EXPIRED status.

locked_out.description: Percentage of users currently locked out
locked_out.x-epack-summary: Share of people who are locked out, usually after repeated failed sign-ins. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
locked_out.x-epack-method: Divides the users with the LOCKED_OUT status by the users other than deprovisioned ones.

locked_out_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people who are locked out. The Locked-out accounts percentage is this number as a share of total people.
locked_out_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed users with the LOCKED_OUT status.

inactive.description: Percentage of users inactive for 90+ days
inactive.x-epack-summary: Share of people who have not signed in for 90 days or have never signed in. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
inactive.x-epack-method: Divides the users with no sign-in in the 90 days before the run by the users other than deprovisioned ones.

inactive_count.description: People who haven't signed in for 90 days, or ever
inactive_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people who have not signed in for 90 days or have never signed in. The Dormant accounts percentage is this number as a share of total people.
inactive_count.x-epack-method: Counts the users other than deprovisioned ones whose last sign-in is more than 90 days before the run or who have never signed in.

suspended.x-epack-summary: Share of people whose account is suspended. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
suspended.x-epack-method: Divides the users with the SUSPENDED status by the users other than deprovisioned ones.

suspended_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people whose account is suspended. The Suspended accounts percentage is this number as a share of total people.
suspended_count.x-epack-method: Counts the listed users with the SUSPENDED status.

inventory.description: Per-user inventory. Login is the only identifier; profile attributes beyond login are excluded. Capped at 50000 (ACTIVE-first, login-asc).
inventory.x-epack-summary: One row per person, with the login as the only identifier. Up to 50,000 rows, with active accounts first.

status.description: The user's Okta status: STAGED, PROVISIONED, ACTIVE, RECOVERY, LOCKED_OUT, PASSWORD_EXPIRED, or SUSPENDED. Deprovisioned users are not listed.
status.x-epack-summary: The person's Okta status, such as ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, LOCKED_OUT or PASSWORD_EXPIRED. Deprovisioned accounts are not listed.

user_type.description: Coarse classification; raw userType never emitted
user_type.x-epack-summary: Human or Service, from words such as svc or bot in the person's userType attribute. The attribute's own value is left out.

created_at.description: When the user was created, in RFC 3339 UTC.

last_login_at.description: When the user last signed in, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when the user has never signed in.
last_login_at.x-epack-summary: When the person last signed in. Left out when they have never signed in.

last_updated_at.description: When Okta last changed the user's record, in RFC 3339 UTC.
last_updated_at.x-epack-summary: When the account record last changed.

status_changed_at.description: When the user's status last changed, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when Okta reports no status change.
status_changed_at.x-epack-summary: When the account's lifecycle status last changed.

password_changed_at.description: When the user's password last changed, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when Okta reports no password change.
password_changed_at.x-epack-summary: When the password was last changed.

has_active_mfa.description: True when the user has at least one factor with status ACTIVE. Absent, with a gap, when the user's factors could not be read.
has_active_mfa.x-epack-summary: Whether the person has at least one active multi-factor method. Left out when the person's methods could not be read.

has_phishing_resistant_mfa.description: True when one of the user's active factors is WebAuthn, U2F, or FastPass. Absent, with a gap, when the user's factors could not be read.
has_phishing_resistant_mfa.x-epack-summary: Whether one of the person's active methods is a passkey, a security key, or Okta FastPass. Left out when the person's methods could not be read.

factor_type.description: Okta factor type as Okta reports it, such as push, webauthn, sms, email, or token:software:totp.
factor_type.x-epack-summary: Okta factor type, such as webauthn, push, sms, email or token:software:totp.

status.description: The factor's Okta status. Only active factors are listed.
status.x-epack-summary: The factor's Okta status. Only active factors are listed.

enrolled_at.description: When the factor was enrolled, in RFC 3339 UTC.
enrolled_at.x-epack-summary: When the person set up this method.

factors.description: The user's active MFA factors. Absent when the user has none.
factors.x-epack-summary: The person's active multi-factor methods, one entry per enrolled factor.

group_ids.description: Okta IDs of the groups the user belongs to.
group_ids.x-epack-summary: Okta IDs of the groups the person belongs to. They match the IDs in the group inventory.

inventory_truncated.description: True when the user inventory hit the 50000 cap
inventory_truncated.x-epack-summary: Whether the person list stopped at 50,000 rows. The counts and percentages still cover every person.

inventory_dropped.x-epack-summary: Number of people left out of the list by the 50,000-row cap. Accounts that are not ACTIVE are left out first.

apps.x-epack-summary: Single sign-on and automatic account creation and removal across the org's apps.

total_count.description: Apps other than inactive ones, API service apps and Okta's default apps. Every app percentage is a share of this count.
total_count.x-epack-summary: Number of app integrations in the org. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's own Admin Console, Dashboard and Browser Plugin apps are not counted. The single sign-on and automatic account percentages are shares of this number.
total_count.x-epack-method: Lists the org's apps and counts each one whose status is not INACTIVE. API service apps, whose only grant type is client_credentials, are left out. The Okta Admin Console, Okta Dashboard and Okta Browser Plugin apps are left out too. Every org has them.

sso_count.description: Apps in total_count that sign people in with SAML, OIDC or WS-Federation
sso_count.x-epack-summary: Number of apps that sign people in with SAML, OIDC or WS-Federation. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out. Single sign-on adoption is this number as a share of total apps.
sso_count.x-epack-method: Counts the apps whose sign-on mode is SAML 1.1, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect or WS-Federation and whose status is not INACTIVE. API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out.

provisioning_enabled.description: Percentage of apps with automatic user provisioning
provisioning_enabled.x-epack-summary: Share of apps that create or import accounts automatically. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out.
provisioning_enabled.x-epack-method: Divides the apps with the PUSH_NEW_USERS or IMPORT_NEW_USERS feature by the org's apps. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out of both counts.

provisioning_enabled_count.description: Apps in total_count that provision people
provisioning_enabled_count.x-epack-summary: Number of apps that create or import accounts automatically. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out. Auto account creation is this number as a share of total apps.
provisioning_enabled_count.x-epack-method: Counts the apps with the PUSH_NEW_USERS or IMPORT_NEW_USERS feature whose status is not INACTIVE. API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out.

deprovisioning_enabled.description: Percentage of apps with automatic user deprovisioning
deprovisioning_enabled.x-epack-summary: Share of apps that deactivate a person's app account automatically when they are deactivated in Okta. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out.
deprovisioning_enabled.x-epack-method: Divides the apps with the PUSH_USER_DEACTIVATION feature by the org's apps. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out of both counts.

deprovisioning_enabled_count.description: Apps in total_count that deprovision people
deprovisioning_enabled_count.x-epack-summary: Number of apps that deactivate accounts automatically. Inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out. Auto account removal is this number as a share of total apps.
deprovisioning_enabled_count.x-epack-method: Counts the apps with the PUSH_USER_DEACTIVATION feature whose status is not INACTIVE. API service apps and Okta's default apps are left out.

inventory.description: Per-app inventory (label, name, type, sign_on_mode, status, sso_configured, provisioning_configured), including inactive apps, API service apps and Okta's default apps. Capped at 5000 (ACTIVE-first, label-asc).
inventory.x-epack-summary: One row per app, including the apps left out of the counts. Up to 5,000 rows, with active apps first.

label.x-epack-summary: The app's display name as shown to admins and users.

name.description: Name of the Okta app integration the app is built from, such as bookmark or oidc_client.
name.x-epack-summary: Okta's internal catalog name for the app integration.

type.description: App type taken from the sign-on mode: SAML for SAML 1.1, SAML 2.0, and WS-Federation, OIDC for OpenID Connect, BOOKMARK, or SWA for every other mode. An OpenID Connect app whose only grant type is client_credentials is an API service app, and its type is SERVICE.
type.x-epack-summary: SAML, OIDC, BOOKMARK or SWA, taken from the sign-on mode. SAML also covers WS-Federation, and SWA covers every other mode. An API service app is SERVICE.

sign_on_mode.description: The app's Okta sign-on mode, such as SAML_2_0, OPENID_CONNECT, BOOKMARK, or BROWSER_PLUGIN.
sign_on_mode.x-epack-summary: The app's Okta sign-on mode, such as SAML_2_0, OPENID_CONNECT, BOOKMARK or BROWSER_PLUGIN.

status.description: The app's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.
status.x-epack-summary: Whether the app integration is ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

sso_configured.description: True when the app's sign-on mode is SAML 1.1, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, or WS-Federation. False for an API service app, since no one signs in to it.
sso_configured.x-epack-summary: Whether the app signs people in with SAML, OIDC or WS-Federation.

provisioning_configured.description: True when the app's features include pushing or importing new users.
provisioning_configured.x-epack-summary: Whether the app has automatic account creation or import turned on.

inventory_truncated.description: True when the app inventory reached the 5000-app cap and the rest were left out.
inventory_truncated.x-epack-summary: Whether the app list stopped at 5,000 rows. The counts and percentages still cover every app.

inventory_dropped.description: Number of apps left out of the inventory by the cap.
inventory_dropped.x-epack-summary: Number of apps left out of the list by the 5,000-row cap. Inactive apps are left out first.

privileged_access.description: Privileged access counts and MFA coverage
privileged_access.x-epack-summary: How many people hold Okta admin roles and how many of them use MFA.

privileged_users_count.description: Count of active users with any effective Okta admin role
privileged_users_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people with any Okta admin role. Suspended and deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
privileged_users_count.x-epack-method: Reads the roles of each user with an admin role assignment and counts those who hold a role and are not suspended or deprovisioned.

super_admin_count.description: Count of active users with the SUPER_ADMIN role
super_admin_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people with the Super Administrator role, which can do every admin task. Suspended and deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
super_admin_count.x-epack-method: Counts the admins whose role assignments include SUPER_ADMIN.

standing_privileged_users_count.description: Count of active users with standing privileged access
standing_privileged_users_count.x-epack-summary: Number of admins whose access is always on. Every Okta admin role assignment is counted as standing.
standing_privileged_users_count.x-epack-method: Counts every admin, since each Okta admin role assignment is treated as standing access.

privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with any MFA factor enrolled
privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of admins with at least one active MFA method.
privileged_mfa_coverage_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the admins with at least one active factor by all admins.

privileged_mfa_enrolled_count.description: Admins with at least one active factor
privileged_mfa_enrolled_count.x-epack-summary: Number of admins with at least one active MFA method. Admin MFA adoption is this number as a share of all admins.
privileged_mfa_enrolled_count.x-epack-method: Counts the admins with at least one active factor.

privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.description: Percentage of privileged users with phishing-resistant MFA
privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of admins with an active passkey, security key or Okta FastPass.
privileged_phishing_resistant_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the admins with an active WebAuthn, U2F or FastPass factor by all admins.

privileged_phishing_resistant_count.description: Admins with an active WebAuthn, U2F or FastPass factor
privileged_phishing_resistant_count.x-epack-summary: Number of admins with an active passkey, security key or Okta FastPass. Admin phishing-resistant MFA is this number as a share of all admins.
privileged_phishing_resistant_count.x-epack-method: Counts the admins with an active WebAuthn, U2F or FastPass factor.

inventory.x-epack-summary: One row per admin, with their login and admin roles.

roles.description: The admin roles assigned to the user: the role type for a built-in role, such as SUPER_ADMIN, or the label for a custom role.
roles.x-epack-summary: The admin roles assigned to the person, such as SUPER_ADMIN or ORG_ADMIN. A custom role shows its label.

role_assignment_source.description: How the user holds their admin roles: direct when each is assigned to the user, group when each comes through a group, or mixed for both.
role_assignment_source.x-epack-summary: Whether the person's admin roles are assigned directly, through a group, or both.

last_login_at.description: When the user last signed in, in RFC 3339 UTC. Absent when the user has never signed in.
last_login_at.x-epack-summary: When this admin last signed in. Left out when they have never signed in.

has_active_mfa.description: True when the admin has at least one factor with status ACTIVE. Absent, with a gap, when the admin's factors could not be read.
has_active_mfa.x-epack-summary: Whether the admin has at least one active multi-factor method. Left out when the admin's methods could not be read.

has_phishing_resistant_mfa.description: True when one of the admin's active factors is WebAuthn, U2F, or FastPass. Absent, with a gap, when the admin's factors could not be read.
has_phishing_resistant_mfa.x-epack-summary: Whether one of the admin's active methods is a passkey, a security key, or Okta FastPass. Left out when the admin's methods could not be read.

custom_roles.description: Custom admin roles (Okta Identity Governance feature). Absent, with a not_licensed gap, when Identity Governance is not licensed. Okta's built-in Workflows Administrator role (WORKFLOWS_ADMIN), which Okta lists with the custom roles, is left out.
custom_roles.x-epack-summary: Custom admin roles defined in the org. Not collected when the org does not license Okta Identity Governance.

name.x-epack-summary: Okta's ID for the custom role.

description.description: The custom role's description in Okta. Absent when it has none.
description.x-epack-summary: The administrator-written description of what the custom role is for.

permission_count.description: Number of permissions the custom role grants. Null, with a gap, when its permissions could not be read.
permission_count.x-epack-summary: Number of permissions the custom role grants.

policy.description: Aggregated security policy settings across all active policies
policy.x-epack-summary: Settings drawn from the org's active sign-on and MFA-enrollment policies, evaluated across the directory.

policy_count.x-epack-summary: Number of active sign-on policies. Their rules set who must use MFA and how long sessions last.
policy_count.x-epack-method: Counts the org's sign-on policies with the ACTIVE status.

mfa_required_all.description: Whether MFA is required for all non-deprovisioned users after evaluating active policies and rules
mfa_required_all.x-epack-summary: Whether the active policies require MFA for every person. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
mfa_required_all.x-epack-method: Checks whether the MFA requirement covers every user other than deprovisioned ones.

mfa_required_any.description: Whether MFA is required for at least one non-deprovisioned user after evaluating active policies and rules
mfa_required_any.x-epack-summary: Whether the active policies require MFA for at least one person.
mfa_required_any.x-epack-method: Checks whether the MFA requirement covers at least one user.

mfa_required_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of non-deprovisioned users covered by an MFA requirement
mfa_required_coverage_pct.x-epack-summary: Share of people that the active policies require to use MFA. Deprovisioned accounts are not counted.
mfa_required_coverage_pct.x-epack-method: Divides the users an MFA requirement covers by the users other than deprovisioned ones.

mfa_required_users_count.description: People covered by an MFA requirement
mfa_required_users_count.x-epack-summary: Number of people that the active policies require to use MFA. MFA requirement coverage is this number as a share of total people.
mfa_required_users_count.x-epack-method: Counts the users who must use a factor at every sign-in their sign-on rules allow, or whose first matching enrollment rule is set to LOGIN. Policies and rules are read in Okta's priority order, and a policy with no rule for the user leaves them to the next policy. A rule with a network zone or another sign-in condition covers only the sign-ins that meet it.

session_lifetime_min_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets a session lifetime
session_lifetime_min_minutes.description: Shortest session lifetime across active sign-on rules (in minutes)
session_lifetime_min_minutes.x-epack-summary: Shortest session lifetime that an active sign-on rule sets, in minutes. Rules that set no limit are not counted.
session_lifetime_min_minutes.x-epack-method: Takes the shortest session lifetime among the active rules of active sign-on policies, leaving out rules that set no limit.

session_lifetime_max_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets a session lifetime
session_lifetime_max_minutes.description: Longest session lifetime across active sign-on rules (in minutes)
session_lifetime_max_minutes.x-epack-summary: Longest session lifetime that an active sign-on rule sets, in minutes. Rules that set no limit are not counted.
session_lifetime_max_minutes.x-epack-method: Takes the longest session lifetime among the active rules of active sign-on policies, leaving out rules that set no limit.

idle_timeout_min_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets an idle timeout
idle_timeout_min_minutes.description: Shortest idle timeout across active sign-on rules (in minutes)
idle_timeout_min_minutes.x-epack-summary: Shortest idle time before sign-out that an active sign-on rule sets, in minutes. Rules that set no limit are not counted.
idle_timeout_min_minutes.x-epack-method: Takes the shortest idle timeout among the active rules of active sign-on policies, leaving out rules that set no limit.

idle_timeout_max_minutes.x-epack-null: No active sign-on rule sets an idle timeout
idle_timeout_max_minutes.description: Longest idle timeout across active sign-on rules (in minutes)
idle_timeout_max_minutes.x-epack-summary: Longest idle time before sign-out that an active sign-on rule sets, in minutes. Rules that set no limit are not counted.
idle_timeout_max_minutes.x-epack-method: Takes the longest idle timeout among the active rules of active sign-on policies, leaving out rules that set no limit.

policies.description: Per-policy summary (name, type, status, priority, rule_count, scope_summary) for sign-on and MFA-enroll policies.
policies.x-epack-summary: One row per active sign-on or MFA enrollment policy.

type.description: The policy type: OKTA_SIGN_ON for a global session policy or MFA_ENROLL for an authenticator enrollment policy.
type.x-epack-summary: OKTA_SIGN_ON for a global session policy, or MFA_ENROLL for an authenticator enrollment policy.

status.description: The policy's Okta status. Only active policies are listed.
status.x-epack-summary: The policy's Okta status. Only active policies are listed.

priority.description: The policy's priority among policies of its type. Okta evaluates lower numbers first.
priority.x-epack-summary: The policy's order among policies of its type. Lower numbers are evaluated first.

rule_count.description: Number of rules in the policy, active or not.
rule_count.x-epack-summary: Number of rules in the policy, active or not.

scope_summary.description: everyone when the policy names no one to include or includes the built-in Everyone group, as each default policy does. group-assigned when it includes only other groups or named users. Left out, with a gap, when the policy includes groups and the group list could not be read.
scope_summary.x-epack-summary: everyone when the policy applies to all users, as the default policies do. group-assigned when it covers only some groups or people.

priority.description: The rule's priority within its policy. Okta evaluates lower numbers first.
priority.x-epack-summary: The rule's order within its policy. Lower numbers are evaluated first.

status.description: The rule's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.
status.x-epack-summary: The rule's Okta status, ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

network_connection.description: The rule's network condition: ANYWHERE, ZONE, or ON_NETWORK. Absent when the rule sets none.
network_connection.x-epack-summary: The rule's network condition, ANYWHERE, ZONE or ON_NETWORK. Left out when the rule sets none.

network_zones_included.description: Okta IDs of the network zones the rule's network condition includes.
network_zones_included.x-epack-summary: Okta IDs of the network zones the rule's network condition includes. They match the IDs in the network zone inventory.

groups_included.description: Okta IDs of the groups the rule applies to. Absent when the rule names none.
groups_included.x-epack-summary: Okta IDs of the groups the rule applies to. Left out when the rule names none.

groups_excluded.description: Okta IDs of the groups the rule excludes.
groups_excluded.x-epack-summary: Okta IDs of the groups the rule leaves out.

device_managed.description: The rule's managed-device condition, "true" or "false" as Okta reports it. Absent when the rule sets none.
device_managed.x-epack-summary: The rule's managed-device condition, true or false as text. Left out when the rule sets none.

access.description: For a sign-on rule, whether it allows or denies the sign-on: ALLOW or DENY.
access.x-epack-summary: Whether the rule allows or denies a matching sign-in, ALLOW or DENY.

require_factor.description: For a sign-on rule, true when it requires a second factor.
require_factor.x-epack-summary: Whether the rule requires a second factor.

factor_prompt_mode.description: For a sign-on rule, when Okta asks for the second factor: ALWAYS, DEVICE, or SESSION.
factor_prompt_mode.x-epack-summary: When the rule asks for the second factor. DEVICE asks once per device, SESSION once per session, and ALWAYS at every sign-in.

max_session_lifetime_minutes.description: For a sign-on rule, the longest a session can last, in minutes. 0 means no limit.
